basic_info.description: Magnificent two-level condo with extensive, sweeping views from the Golden Gate Bridge to beyond Alcatraz, beautiful architectural details, decks, and a flowering garden. Three bedrooms and two and a half baths. The three bedrooms are on the same level with two full baths and a patio. The kitchen, living room, and formal dining room all have unobstructed, gorgeous views and terraces and a powder room. This residence has its own level garden with flowering trees. The building was completely re-built to-the-studs and has had additional more recent upgrades. Work included foundation, seismic, roof, and more. Excellent floor plan over two levels.
